promql-prometheus-3.1.0/fact/rate-extrap.description: Observe: Require at least two same-kind observations and remove mixed float/hist windows with warning. Difference last-first is counter-corrected by adding the previous value for each decrease. Let observed span S and mean gap A=S/(n-1). Each edge gap >=1.1*A is replaced by A/2; otherwise keep it. logql-loki-3.5.2/variants/positive.description: Evaluate count and byte-rate variants from the same entries.

logql-loki-3.5.2/variants/interaction.description: Enable gate and combine one failing variant with one valid variant.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-entry-merge/po.description: Merge two replica iterators containing one identical line and one distinct line at the same nanosecond.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-entry-merge/ne.description: Do not collapse distinct line bytes just because stream and timestamp match.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-entry-merge/in.description: Compare single iterator and multi-iterator paths, stream hash unavailable and both directions.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-sample-merge/p.description: Merge replicas with equal nonzero hash and preserve a distinct hash.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-sample-merge/n.description: Do not deduplicate zero-hash samples solely because values match.

logql-loki-3.5.2/iterator-sample-merge/i.description: Use repeated samples within one iterator and across iterators; preserve the pinned merge encounter order.

logql-loki-3.5.2/first-last-ties/positiv.description: Feed same timestamp with distinct values in a known iterator order.

logql-loki-3.5.2/first-last-ties/negativ.description: Do not resolve equal-time ties by minimum/maximum value.

logql-loki-3.5.2/first-last-ties/interac.description: Reverse underlying equal-time observation order while leaving timestamps unchanged; compare overlap and streaming paths.

logql-loki-3.5.2/shard-capability-domain.description: Reject approx_topk with grouping or nonpositive k; disabled shardable approximation fails rather than exact top-k fallback.
Exercise unknown and duplicate shard names, zero shards and unshardable nested child paths.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/multi-variant-quer.description: With gate disabled, reject gated expression/admission.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/structured-metadat.description: With gate disabled, reject gated expression/admission.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/shard-first_over_t.description: With sharded optimization disabled, evaluate the corresponding exact range operation without that rewrite; disabling optimization does not remove language syntax.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/shard-last_over_ti.description: With sharded optimization disabled, evaluate the corresponding exact range operation without that rewrite; disabling optimization does not remove language syntax.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/shard-quantile_ove.description: With sharded optimization disabled, evaluate the corresponding exact range operation without that rewrite; disabling optimization does not remove language syntax.

logql-loki-3.5.2/gate/approx_topk/disabl.description: With gate disabled, reject gated expression/admission.

logql-loki-3.5.2/primitive/unicode-case-.description: Compare ASCII and preexisting Greek case mappings.
Compare post-Unicode15 Garay case/category membership; host Unicode17 output must not become reference truth.
Use same post15 text in ToLower/lower/title, regexp named extraction and regex line/label filters.

logql-loki-3.5.2/primitive/template-vers.description: Execute nested fromJson maps/arrays using variables, index and range.
Reject a control action or builtin/type combination absent from reference version; do not enable newer host conveniences.
Compare missing map key, nil intermediate access, short-circuit and/or and time.Time methods across compiler versions.

logql-loki-3.5.2/primitive/regexp-engine.description: Match multiline named captures and expanded replacement.
Reject lookbehind/backreferences and malformed repetition according to pinned engine.
Exercise empty captures, Unicode categories, newline dot flags, label anchoring and literal-vs-expanded replacement.

logql-loki-3.5.2/primitive/numeric-strin.description: Parse valid scientific decimal and preserve negative zero.
Exercise overflow, malformed numeric strings and invalid UTF8 rather than coercing all failures to successful zero.
Contrast explicit any-accepting Sprig casts, strict template string parameters and unwrap ParseFloat failure labeling.

logql-loki-3.5.2/primitive/time-stdlib-v.description: Format entry timestamp in a frozen UTC process.
Reject malformed unixToTime length while preserving toDate zero-time behavior.
Exercise preepoch nanoseconds, DST fold/gap with pinned zone data and now versus __timestamp__.
